name: week
title: Organisation review
subtitle: Position snapshots, costs and review findings. Fictional demo data.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.sql: select code,name,status,owner,source_as_of,review_on from scenarios order by code

sections.title: Review findings
sections.sql: select s.code,f.rule,f.finding from review_findings f join scenarios s on s.id=f.scenario_id order by s.code,f.rule

sections.title: Department capacity
sections.sql: select s.code,d.department,d.currency,d.positions,d.fte,d.vacant_fte,d.annual_cost_amount from department_costs d join scenarios s on s.id=d.scenario_id order by s.code,d.department,d.currency

sections.title: Reporting layers
sections.sql: select s.code as scenario,l.code,l.title,l.layer,l.path from position_layers l join scenarios s on s.id=l.scenario_id order by s.code,l.path
